SELECT cls, COUNT(*) AS trips, SUM(anglers) AS anglers, SUM(yt) AS yt,
       ROUND(SUM(yt)/NULLIF(SUM(anglers),0),4) AS ypa
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_season = 2 AND fish_date_doy BETWEEN 152 AND 182
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY ypa DESC
SELECT index_id, value, avail_doy FROM climate WHERE avail_season=2 ORDER BY avail_doy DESC LIMIT 8
